description: This file contains the implementation of the 'vtSaveTask' function, which handles saving or updating a workflow task in the vtiger CRM system. It includes logic for access control, task creation or retrieval, setting task properties from request parameters, and redirecting after completion.

classes.name: VTWorkflowUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for workflow management, such as access checks.

classes.name: VTWorkflowApplication
classes.description: Represents a workflow application context, providing methods for URL generation and language support.

classes.name: VTTaskManager
classes.description: Manager class for creating, retrieving, and saving workflow tasks.

methods.name: vtSaveTask
methods.description: Main function that processes request data to save or update a workflow task, checks admin permissions, and redirects accordingly.
